peer_identity.arc_label: Warrior who fell at Marmola during Othon's era—unrelated to Princess Oda Capricious
peer_identity.honcho_notes: Spoken of only in memorial narration; no direct voice. Death described as entering 'silence, the soul of all things.' Associated with Othon and Bari's funerary mourning scene. A story object, not an ongoing actor.
peer_identity.rationale: This Oda is eulogized at a funerary slab in vol02 as a warrior who 'fought ferociously until the end' during the Marmola battle in Othon's era—generations before Princess Oda Capricious appears. The name is shared but the people are entirely different: one is a fallen clansman, the other is a princess from Baggadathi. Keeping them on the same card would create completely incompatible facts.
